title: Certified authority and order packet

bodyBlocks.text: Certified authority and order packet · complete relevant records. For this fictional case, badges are individual and unshared; records are reliable and untampered. There is no delegation, impersonation, collusion, queued delay or offline substitution. Actions take effect immediately at the recorded case time. Nothing outside this packet is needed to identify the first diversion.

The documented cradle-and-recipient diversion requires BOTH repack and redirect authority at the issue time. Review alone cannot change custody. Authority starts are inclusive and ends exclusive. All times below are already case time; do not apply the service-clock correction again.
